prerequisites: A separately authorized inference window; this command dispatches one real benchmark inference.
Docker Linux engine healthy and an approved Harbor worker image already present; do not pull images during qualification.
A managed candidate Monitor on port 8789 with isolated descriptor/state/database paths, gateway enabled, and upstream http://127.0.0.1:1235.
Fresh authenticated Monitor status and Coordinator readiness with matching runtime identities, protected upstream, and no active safety restrictions.
The model selector must appear in a fresh LM Studio model inventory; the live inventory in this qualification was empty.
Harbor 0.25.0 and the frozen Aider dataset revision must pass the suite's pre-dispatch checks.
Host resource and mining telemetry must remain stable before and during the run.

remaining_blockers: Docker Desktop engine returned HTTP 500 and a Docker version request hung; no container route can be qualified until daemon startup is healthy under an authorized low-contention window.
LM Studio reported zero models, so no benchmark is execution-ready.
Coordinator port 1235 had no listener and its prior runtime PID was absent on the final post-cleanup check; cause is unknown and it was not restarted.
Production Monitor on port 8788 was absent; no authenticated Monitor status or runtime contract could be verified.
No Harbor image inventory was read because the Docker engine was unavailable; no image was pulled or container created.
KRig hashrate/share telemetry was not collected, so the transient GPU telemetry change cannot be translated into mining output impact.
